summary: Worcester County, MA tower on Wigwam Hill: first tower 1916 with a watchman, new 70 ft tower 1954 (register says 1955), still standing in a 2011 photo; current staffing unconfirmed.

facts.status_note: Last dated photo in the sources read is from 2011; current condition and use are not confirmed
facts.agency: Mass. Bureau of Forest Fire Control, District 7

events.note: First 50-foot tower on Wigwam Hill, in operation May 1916
A watchman was installed when the first tower opened
New 70-foot tower, public dedication August 20, 1954; the old tower was later torn down

evidence.supports: first tower placed into operation in 1916 to cover southern Worcester County
evidence.quote: The first Mendon Fire Tower was placed into operation in 1916 to cover southern Worcester County and triangulate with lookouts in northern Rhode Island.

evidence.supports: first tower 50 feet high, opened May 1916 when a watchman was installed
evidence.quote: The tower was 50 feet high and was opened for the first time in May 1916 when a watchman was installed.

evidence.supports: state announced a tower for Wigwam Hill in 1915
evidence.quote: the State was to begin, at once, the erection of a fire tower on Wigwam Hill

evidence.supports: fire warden of Mendon was told in August 1915
evidence.quote: Frank M. Aldrich, Fire Warden of Mendon, received word in August of 1915

evidence.supports: tower stands at the highest point on Wigwam Hill
evidence.quote: The fire tower, indicated on the map, is the highest point on Wigwam Hill.

evidence.supports: Town Forest located near the Millville and Uxbridge town lines
evidence.quote: It is located in the South-western corner of Mendon near the Millville & Uxbridge town lines.
In 1954 a new 70 foot high fire tower was built.

evidence.supports: public dedication of the new tower on August 20, 1954
evidence.quote: A public dedication of the newly completed fire tower was held on August 20, 1954

evidence.supports: new tower about 20 feet taller; old tower later torn down
evidence.quote: The new tower rose 20 feet above the old one which stood nearby which was later torn down.

evidence.supports: register gives 1955 as the build year of the present 70-foot steel tower
evidence.quote: The present 70' steel tower with 10'x10' cab was built in 1955.

evidence.supports: photograph from 2011 shows the tower standing

corrections.current: 1955 (register Built field), before the 2026-10-09 check; story and events now use 1954
corrections.why: The local Town Forest history dates the new tower to 1954 and gives an August 20, 1954 dedication. The register's own photo caption reads 1954 for the current tower, though its Built field says 1955.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register text gives 1955 but its photo caption dates the current tower to 1954; the local Town Forest history gives 1954 and a dedication on August 20, 1954. The story uses 1954 and says the sources differ by a year.

notes_for_editor: The build year conflicts within the register and with the local Town Forest history; see corrections. The Mendon Town Forest page is a private local history (2012) that cites Milford Daily News coverage from 1954, so it is secondary but specific. A lookout-history page found by search (firelookout.org, 404 from the cache, not quoted) reportedly places the tower on Chestnut Hill and gives April 1, 1916 as the first operation date and a 2003 cab; none of that is in the story. Status is standing on the 2011 photo and the register's present-tense description; no current staffing or access record was read. No access key is set: the town page implies the site is not set up for recreation, but that is interpretation. Used 2 WebSearch calls and 5 readable page reads including the Town Forest history and the DCR program page.
